backup.folderMissing: Folder not there (not plugged in or not mounted): {{path}}
backup.folderNotWritable: The Stage-Server may not write to this folder.
backup.sameDisk: The folder is on the same disk as the data - is the drive not mounted? Pick a second drive.
backup.folderOk: Folder is writable and on a drive of its own.
backup.sshKeyMissing: The server's SSH key is missing.

calibration.busy: A measurement is already running - please wait a moment.

band.noneActive: No band is active on this Stage-Server.
band.activeAdminOnly: Only an admin of the active band.

speech.pluginMissing: The piper-speech plugin is not installed.
speech.downloadBusy: A download is already running, or the voice is unknown.

stems.demucsMissing: Demucs is not installed on the Stage-Server (docs/03).
stems.notInstalled: Stem separation is not installed on the Stage-Server (Demucs, see docs/03).

osc.noTarget: This OSC device has no host and port (Stage tech).

job.interrupted: Interrupted by a restart of the Stage-Server.
job.variantGone: The song variant no longer exists.
job.audioMissing: The track's audio file is not on the Stage-Server.
job.stemPluginMissing: The "Separate tracks" plugin is not installed.

youtube.addonMissing: The "YouTube download" add-on is not installed for this band.
youtube.bandMissing: The YouTube search is missing the band (add-on check).
youtube.downloadTimeout: yt-dlp had not finished after {{minutes}} minutes and was stopped.
youtube.tooLarge: The audio is larger than the limit of {{mb}} MB.
youtube.searchTimeout: The YouTube search did not answer - is the Stage-Server online?
youtube.noAudio: YouTube offers no downloadable audio for this video.
youtube.noOpus: YouTube offers no Opus for this video - converting on the device is still to come.
youtube.interrupted: The download was interrupted (app closed) - please start it again.

ug.addonMissing: The "Ultimate Guitar Import" add-on is not installed for this band.
ug.bandMissing: Ultimate Guitar is missing the band (add-on check).
ug.chromePathWrong: CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH points to "{{path}}" - there is no Chrome/Chromium there. Fix the path or remove the variable.
ug.chromeMissing: For Ultimate Guitar the Stage-Server needs Chrome or Chromium - none found. Install it (e.g. "sudo apt install chromium") or set CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH. Looked in: {{paths}}
ug.timeout: Ultimate Guitar does not answer ({{seconds}} s). Check the Stage-Server's internet connection and try again.
ug.unavailable: Ultimate Guitar is not reachable - does the Stage-Server have internet right now?
ug.blocked: Ultimate Guitar blocked the request as a bot. Try again in a few minutes.
ug.sourceChanged: Ultimate Guitar rebuilt its site - the import (plugin "ultimate-guitar-scraper") needs an update. Page title: "{{title}}"
ug.notImportable: This version has no text to take over (e.g. a Pro or video version). Please pick another version.

helper.missing: The add-on's helper is not installed on this device.
helper.untrusted: The helper is signed by someone else - StageBoard won't use it.
helper.incompatible: The helper does not fit this StageBoard version.
helper.badRequest: The helper did not understand the request.
helper.tooOld: The helper is too old for this StageBoard version.
